authority: CIO explicit delegated temporal consumption design decision in current task

supersedes.rule: same observation D and execution D; next-day carry forbidden

rules: D must be the independently verified immediately previous completed trading session before actual execution session E, derived from the existing verified trading calendar. Calendar uncertainty yields UNKNOWN; neither calendar-day subtraction nor D-2 fallback is allowed.

Retain original D leadership/rotation observation dates, actual publication/retrieval/admission and first-seen times. All must be actually available before the E decision. Bind exact D source snapshots and reviewed code/config hashes independently of the submitted payload.

The D context can authorize this bounded entry filter only within the immediately following verified session E. No new entry consumption after E closes, no E+1 carry or relabeling D as current real-time market evidence.

E candidate identity/tradability/master and membership must be actually valid at the E decision and forward execution instants. Never extend a historical D master interval [D,D+1) into E or backdate new membership. Apply the explicitly approved classification sources prospectively to independently verified current E identity.

All price/spread/impact/entry/exit observations remain current qualified E sources. Preserve original600-second slot window, decision expiry, causal ordering, costs/risk/score. D closing price cannot become an E execution fill.

Same-date validation remains within the D market context and within E execution inputs. Only an explicit verified D-to-E relation joins them. Receipts must label the context as previous completed session. This decision does not automatically satisfy a separate regime gate that requires actual E-day source/state; validate that combination independently.
No risk/cost/score thresholds or global/REAL authority change. Adopted temporal experiment design does not prove profitability.
validation_required: Actual existing consumer D/E positive path.
Reject future availability, non-immediate D, and expired E membership.
Qualified E forward observations and actual ledger consumption remain separately required.
